metadata.description: Unit placements July 2, 1863, approximately 11:10am to 2:35pm. Covers: 1st Minnesota charge, Wright's Cemetery Ridge breakthrough, Willard's countercharge, Barksdale mortally wounded, McGilvery Plum Run Line, Cemetery Hill assault by Louisiana Tigers and Avery, Carroll's counterattack, Greene's lone stand on Culp's Hill, Johnson's attack on Culp's Hill, Stuart arriving.

placements.notes: 1st MINNESOTA CHARGING into Wilcox's brigade. Hancock orders 262 men against 1700. Buying 5 minutes.
Wilcox's Alabama brigade advancing toward Cemetery Ridge gap
Bigelow's last stand at Trostle Farm wall -- nearly out of men
McGilvery's Plum Run Line forming
Hart's battery in Plum Run Line
1st Minnesota -- 224 of 262 men down in 15 minutes. 85.5% casualties. 38 survivors.
Wilcox stopped -- 5 minutes bought. Union reinforcements arriving.
Wright's Georgia brigade BREAKING THROUGH Cemetery Ridge
Harrow's brigade pushed back by Wright's breakthrough
Wright reaches the crest of Cemetery Ridge -- briefly among Union guns
Carroll's brigade counterattacking to drive Wright back
Wright driven back from Cemetery Ridge crest -- no Confederate support arrived
Wilcox falling back -- repulsed
Florida brigade (Lang) retreating with Wilcox
Willard's brigade charging Barksdale's exhausted Confederates near Plum Run
Barksdale's brigade -- Barksdale mortally wounded. Humphreys assumes command.
Willard KIA by artillery shell while commanding charge. Sherrill assumes. US-013.
Crawford's Pennsylvania Reserves charging down Little Round Top western slope
Wofford's brigade driven back by Crawford's charge
Bigelow's battery -- withdrawal complete. Mission accomplished. McGilvery's line holds.
Webb's brigade at The Angle -- line restored after Wright's breakthrough
Cushing's battery still at The Angle
38 survivors of 1st Minnesota in line on Cemetery Ridge
Stonewall Brigade advancing on Culp's Hill
Jones's brigade advancing
Steuart's brigade -- will penetrate into empty XII Corps works
GREENE'S LONE STAND -- 1424 men holding against 6500 Confederates
Stonewall Brigade assaulting Greene's position
Greene holding -- breastworks doing the work bodies cannot
Steuart's brigade occupying EMPTY XII Corps breastworks on lower Culp's Hill
Greene still holding upper Culp's Hill
XII Corps returning to Culp's Hill -- finding Confederate troops in their works
LOUISIANA TIGERS CHARGING Cemetery Hill at dusk
Avery's brigade charging Cemetery Hill alongside Hays
Von Steinwehr holding Cemetery Hill -- Louisiana Tigers coming up the slope
Ricketts's battery on Cemetery Hill -- Louisiana Tigers reaching the guns
Louisiana Tigers ON THE CREST of Cemetery Hill -- briefly holding Union guns
Avery mortally wounded on slope -- writing blood message. CS-014.
Carroll's brigade counterattacking Cemetery Hill -- driving Louisiana Tigers back
Louisiana Tigers driven back -- without Confederate infantry support they cannot hold
Avery's brigade retreating. Godwin now commands. CS-014.
Greene still holding upper Culp's Hill after full night of fighting
Steuart holding lower Culp's Hill works overnight
Stonewall Brigade dug in on Culp's Hill
XII Corps returned and dug in -- Confederates hold lower works
Webb's brigade -- Cemetery Ridge line restored and holding
Cushing's battery still at The Angle -- end of Day 2 evening action
Garnett's brigade behind Seminary Ridge -- being briefed for tomorrow's charge
Kemper's brigade -- being briefed for Pickett's Charge
Armistead's brigade -- Armistead tells his men what tomorrow will bring
Pettigrew's brigade on Seminary Ridge -- will lead left column of July 3 assault
Lane's brigade -- severely reduced from July 1 fighting
Vermont Brigade on Cemetery Ridge -- Stannard will use them tomorrow
20th Maine holds Little Round Top -- 130 casualties from today's fighting
15th Alabama reformed south of Round Tops
Greene's brigade still on Culp's Hill -- held all night
Steuart in lower Culp's Hill works -- to be contested all day July 3
